title: Navigate to Event Types from Setup menu
preconditions: User is logged in with admin credentials
steps: Log in to staging; Locate Setup/Configuration menu; Click Event Types menu item
expected_result: Event Types list page loads without errors and displays existing event types

title: Event Types list displays correct columns and data
preconditions: User is on the Event Types list page
steps: Navigate to Event Types list page; Observe table headers and content
expected_result: List shows Name column; existing records are displayed without UI errors

title: Create a new Event Type with valid data
preconditions: User is on the Event Types list page
steps: Click Add/New button; Enter name 'TestEventType_Auto'; Fill other required fields; Click Save
expected_result: New event type created and appears in list; success notification shown

title: Create Event Type form contains required fields and controls
preconditions: User is on the Event Types list page
steps: Click Add/New button; Observe the form that appears
expected_result: Form shows Name field and Save/Cancel buttons

title: Edit an existing Event Type successfully
preconditions: At least one Event Type exists
steps: Navigate to list; Click Edit on existing Event Type; Modify name to 'UpdatedEventType_Auto'; Click Save
expected_result: Event Type updated; list reflects change; success message shown

title: Edit form pre-populates existing values
preconditions: At least one Event Type exists
steps: Navigate to list; Click Edit on existing record; Observe form fields
expected_result: All form fields are pre-populated with current saved values

title: Delete an Event Type successfully
preconditions: At least one deletable Event Type exists
steps: Navigate to list; Click Delete on target Event Type; Confirm deletion
expected_result: Event Type removed from list; success notification shown; gone on refresh

title: Cancel delete keeps Event Type in list
preconditions: At least one Event Type exists
steps: Navigate to list; Click Delete on Event Type; Click Cancel in dialog
expected_result: Event Type remains in list unchanged; no deletion occurs

title: Validation error shown when Event Type name is empty
preconditions: Create Event Type form is open
steps: Click Add to open form; Leave Name field blank; Click Save
expected_result: Validation error displayed: Name is required; no record created

title: Validation error shown for whitespace-only Event Type name
preconditions: Create Event Type form is open
steps: Click Add to open form; Enter only spaces in Name field; Click Save
expected_result: Validation error shown; whitespace-only input rejected

title: Duplicate Event Type name is rejected with error
steps: Click Add; Enter 'TestEventType_Auto' as name; Click Save
expected_result: Error: name already in use; no duplicate created

title: Newly created Event Type appears in downstream selector
steps: Navigate to Incident creation form; Open Event Type selector; Search for 'TestEventType_Auto'
expected_result: Newly created Event Type available in downstream dropdown

title: Search input narrows Event Types list correctly
preconditions: Multiple Event Types exist in list
steps: Navigate to list; Type partial name in search/filter; Observe results
expected_result: Only Event Types matching search term are displayed

title: Search with no matching term shows empty state
preconditions: Event Types list page is open
expected_result: Empty state or 'No results found' message shown

title: Admin user has full CRUD access to Event Types
steps: Navigate to Event Types; Verify Add/Edit/Delete controls visible; Confirm each functional
expected_result: Admin sees and can use all CRUD controls without permission errors

title: Event Types page UI elements are correctly rendered
preconditions: User is on Event Types list page
steps: Navigate to list; Inspect page title/headers/buttons; Resize to 768px width
expected_result: Labels and buttons correctly named; layout adapts without overflow

title: Create Event Type with maximum allowed character name
preconditions: Create Event Type form is open
steps: Click Add; Enter 255-character name; Click Save
expected_result: Event Type created OR clear character-limit error shown; no system error

title: Event Types page loads within acceptable performance threshold
steps: Navigate to Event Types list page; Measure page load time
